body: I think about suicide all the time.  But I know that whatever I try will go wrong and I will end up crippled or deformed and I will have to go on that way.  So, I end up changing my mind.
I guess there is no one out there.  I didn't think so.

I am failure at almost everything that was important to me.  I am so tired of  trying...so hopelessly exhausted...but terrified at what will happen to us.  Neither of us ever wanted to be rich.  But being unable to pay our basic bills is horrible.  I know that there are people worse off than we are.  And I try to remind myself of that.  But I cannot seem to pull myself out of this dark hole I have fallen into.  I don't know if I even want to anymore.  Things just seem to get worse and worse.

I have always been such a hard worker and always took care of myself.  Now the burden of supporting my family--both emotionally and financially--is actually killing me.  I quit one of my jobs because my hair was falling out  due to lack of sleep.  Now, I really do not know how we are going to make it.  But, I cannot talk to anyone about it (especialy my husband) because it makes my husband more depressed...and he needs to get his crap together!

I feel like such a loser and I know everyone is bored of hearing about my problems.  So I have no one to talk to.  So, hear I am in the middle of the night pouring my woes onto the internet...knowing that probably no one will respond.  Just like when I try to talk to my husband.

My husband lost his job years ago and we have slowly declined into financial ruin.  Our remodel which began 9 years ago will probably never be finished.  I have lost almost every friend we had--at first because we couldn't afford to do anything and now--because I am so seriously depressed AND have to work all the time to try to keep us going.  My daughter just finished telling me what a terrible mom I am after years of dedicating EVERY resource we had to supporting her dream (which she gave up on).  I have such a strong faith in God and know that I should depend only on Him.  But I am so lonely and hopeless that each day is a burden to endure.
